title: ohneis652 — Side A: a music site that feels like flipping through a record-store shelf
note: A music site that feels like flipping through a shelf in a tiny record store — pick something up, drop it into the player, lean in and find details you'd normally never notice. The workflow: three reference sites for animation/layout/type, Claude building every device in Blender via MCP (not AI-generated 3D), Figma plan first, Claude coding Three.js scroll-click-scroll shelf navigation, six AI album covers, GLB/OBJ export, plus free repos Blender MCP, Trellis.2, Nerfstudio. Honest limit: he does not publish the literal prompts — the full setup is gated behind commenting CODE on the post. Her steals: the shelf as a navigation pattern, the Blender-via-MCP rule, and the no-placeholders rule.
